customer: I'm trying to sell my SUV and now I'm told my wife has to sign too? Her name's on the title with mine, but she's visiting our daughter out of state for the next month, and I'm not about to wait around that long. Is there really no way to do this without her?
agent: I understand the frustration, and I'll walk you through how it works per our article "When more than one person owns the car." If the names on your title are joined by "or," only one owner needs to sign, so you could handle the sale yourself. If they're joined by "and," every owner has to sign. Since your wife can't come to the appraisal appointment, she can sign a power of attorney, form NW-POA-1, which must be notarized.
